votes.motion: Enter into Closed Session as the RDA Board and City Council for the purposes of strategy sessions to discuss the purchase, exchange, or lease of real property, and attorney-client matters that are privileged pursuant to Utah Code § 78B-1-137, and for other lawful purposes that satisfy the pertinent requirements of the Utah Open and Public Meetings Act.
votes.description: The Board voted to enter into a closed session jointly with the City Council to discuss real property transactions and attorney-client privileged matters.
The Board voted to conclude the closed session and return to open session.
